checkpoint.description: Checkpoint is the last leader operation applied here.

leader_checkpoint.description:
LeaderCheckpoint is the last operation the leader acknowledged when
it was last asked.

term.description:
Term names the leader history Checkpoint counts in; empty until the
follower bootstrapped, and again when it has to bootstrap anew.

replica.description: Replica asks for copies this node replicates: 404 unless it may serve them.

sort_keys.description: SortKeys adds the `_sort_key` the coordinator merges top_hits by.

replicas.description: Replicas are the nodes holding a warm read replica, used for cold indexes.

password.description: write only: listing answers "******", writing "******" or "" keeps the stored one

seeds.description: Seeds are http(s) addresses of nodes of the remote cluster.

skip_unavailable.description:
SkipUnavailable leaves the remote out of a search it fails instead
of failing the search.

username.description:
Username and Password authenticate the background calls of
cross-cluster replication. A search carries the client's credentials.

max_docs.description: MaxDocs limits the number of copied documents, 0 means all of them.

input.description: a string or an array of strings

format.description: format the `to` and `from` values to `_as_string`, and used to format `keyed response`

weight_field.description: Field name to be used for setting weight for primary field for weighted average aggregation

count.description: stats aggregation; pointers so that a zero count / min still serializes

sum_of_squares.description: extended_stats aggregation, in addition to the stats fields above

values.description:
percentiles aggregation, keyed form only: {"1.0": v, ...}.
Elasticsearch returns an array of {key, value} objects when keyed is
false, zed always returns the keyed map.

exclude.description: regexp string or array of terms

include.description: regexp string or array of terms

avg_bucket.description: pipeline aggregations (evaluated on the response tree after bucket aggregations)

filter.description: compatibility with es, alias for TokenFilter
compatibility with es, alias for TokenFilter

delete_after.description: DeleteAfter removes the index entirely; empty keeps it forever.

cluster_shards.description:
ClusterShards spreads the index over that many shard indexes, each
owned, replicated and failed over on its own in a cluster. Set at
creation only; 0 and 1 keep the index on one node.

exclude_source_vectors.description:
ExcludeSourceVectors keeps vector fields out of the stored _source and
restores them from the stored vectors on read; nil takes
zed_exclude_source_vectors. Set at creation only.

index_type.description: IndexType selects the document profile; empty preserves standard indexes.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle drives automatic tier transitions by index age.

tier.description:
Tier is the current data tier: hot (local disk, writable), warm
(object storage, writable) or cold (object storage, read-only,
shared by every node). Empty means hot.

_all.description: All is the `_all` mapping; nil follows zed_all_field.

_source.description: Source is the Elasticsearch `_source` mapping; nil stores _source.

type.description: best_fields(default), most_fields, cross_fields, phrase, phrase_prefix, bool_prefix

value.description: You can speed up prefix queries using the index_prefixes mapping parameter.

fields.description:
Fields allow the same string value to be indexed in multiple ways for different purposes,
such as one field for search and a multi-field for sorting and aggregations,
or the same string value analyzed by different analyzers.
If the Fields property is defined within a sub-field, it will be ignored.

Currently, only "text" fields support the Fields parameter.

format.description: date format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss || yyyy-MM-dd || epoch_millis

index_options.description: IndexOptions enables HNSW approximate search on a vector field by default.

inference_id.description:
InferenceID makes a text field a semantic_text field: documents embed
its value with this endpoint into SemanticEmbeddingField.

properties.description:
Properties holds the sub-fields of a "nested" property. Each element of
the nested array is indexed as its own hidden document tagged with
NestedPathField / NestedParentField so nested queries and aggregations
keep per-object semantics.

relations.description:
Relations defines parent -> children for a "join" property, e.g.
{"question": ["answer", "comment"]}. Documents set the field to
{"name": "answer", "parent": "<parent _id>"} or just "question".

similarity.description: Similarity is the default knn metric of a vector field, cosine when empty.

type.description: text, keyword, date, numeric, boolean, geo_point, vector, nested, join

format.description: Date format used to convert date values in the query.

time_zone.description: used to convert date values in the query to UTC.

_clusters.description: Clusters counts the clusters of a cross-cluster search.

took.description: Time it took to generate the response

type.description:
Type is VectorIndexHNSW or VectorIndexInt8HNSW; empty, as persisted
before types, builds int8 graphs.

ext.description: OpenSearch ext, rerank.query_context of a rerank processor

knn.description: top-level knn: one object or an array, ORed with query

rank.description: legacy Elasticsearch {"rrf": {...}} fusing query and knn

rescore.description: one rescorer or an array, applied in order

retriever.description: Elasticsearch retriever: standard, knn, rrf or linear

search_pipeline.description: inline OpenSearch pipeline of a hybrid query

knn.description: top-level knn: one object or an array, ORed with query

retriever.description: Elasticsearch retriever: standard, knn, rrf or linear

search_pipeline.description: inline OpenSearch pipeline of a hybrid query

follower.description: Follower names the follower index, its lease on the log.

path.description: slash separated, relative to the index directory

weight_field.description: Field name to be used for setting weight for primary field for weighted average aggregation

search_type.description: SearchType is the type of search to perform. Can be match, match_phrase, query_string, etc
